correction.text: When a PO splits an item into several sizes, save time: enter a single line with the total quantity, using the first size listed. The warehouse splits sizes later.
correction.reason: The correction aligns with the principle that the PO is the source of truth. It introduces an optimization for handling POs that split items into multiple sizes, allowing a single line item with total quantity and using the first size listed. This does not alter the core requirement that the order must match the PO exactly, and it improves efficiency without compromising accuracy. The correction is consistent with the demonstrated process and rules.

skill: Select the customer account based on the PO's customer name.
Enter the PO number exactly as written in the PO.
Enter the ship-by date from the PO in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
Look up the product in the catalog and enter its SKU as specified in the PO.
Select the color as specified in the PO.
Select the size as specified in the PO. Use N/A for products that do not have sizes.
Enter the quantity for the product/color/size combination as specified in the PO, converting units like dozens to a numerical value.
Enter the unit price from the PO. If no price is given, use the catalog price.
Add a line item for each product/color/size combination specified in the PO. If a PO splits an item into several sizes, enter a single line with the total quantity using the first size listed.
Submit the order only after verifying that all line items match the PO exactly.
